about: The provider catalogue's overlay as the dashboard's form writes it (frontend/src/lib/catalogueOverlay.ts overlayYaml): each case's yaml is what the form writes for its overlay, and what the catalogue reads back to the same overlay (tests/unit/agents/test_catalogue_overlay_yaml.py). Both sides read this file, so neither can drift from the other.

cases.name: a provider on, a shipped model re-priced
cases.yaml:
providers:
  deepseek:
    enabled: true
    models:
      deepseek-flash:
        prices:
          - {in: 0.15, out: 0.6}

cases.name: a custom model, free and chat-only, its id quoted
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    enabled: true
    models:
      "custom/qwen3:32b":
        free: true
        chat_only: true

cases.name: a model added with whole-dollar and dated prices
cases.yaml:
providers:
  openai:
    enabled: true
    models:
      gpt-new:
        prices:
          - {in: 1.0, out: 2.0}
          - {from: 2026-12-01, in: 2.0, out: 4.0}

cases.name: request extras, nested
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    models:
      custom/local:
        free: true
        request_extras: {"chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":false},"temperature":0.2}

cases.name: the version, factors and a default price
cases.yaml:
version: 1
providers:
  custom:
    factors:
      turns: 2.0
    default_price:
      in: 0.0
      out: 0.0
